name: probe-rows-v2
description: The v2 probe rows of the TerminalEnv degradation matrix (scripts/rl_batch.py; docs/GPU_RUNBOOK.md, 'v2 probe rows: the RL batch'): three runs train against probe_iid (v2, terminal_prerl_v2) on seeds 219-221 and three against probe_ood on seeds 222-224, penalty_coef 1.0. The four Qwen judges are held out and scored live, as in Vlad's rows (seeds 200-218); the other probe is held out too, scored after the runs (experiments/eval_inkling_probes_on_runs.py). Early stop off, as in Vlad's judge rows of commit c30c466 (his controls had 16). n_steps 90, as his rows ran; 360 to see the trained-against monitor fall, which in his batch only the 360-step strong-cot-seed-207 showed.
